title: 第十五章 王府辛秘第十六章 流火返照全本
content_zh:
“夫君，这百合鸡块不错，你尝尝。”
“昱哥哥，黄河鲤是廖师傅的拿手好菜，鱼背最嫩，你吃一块。”
王昱坐在主位，李云岫和芊芊一左一右，方少白坐在客位，赵嵘在侧相陪，赵英杰都没有资格上桌。
桌上八凉八热十六个菜，每人身后都站着一位丫鬟伺候着，随时倒酒夹菜，不会让客人桌前有残羹冷炙。
不过王昱用不着，因为他被李云岫和芊芊伺候的很好。
他也不客气，因为真实的赵昱绝不会客气，一个皇帝赐婚的王妃，一个老爹安排的未婚妻，伺候自己这个王爷不是应该的吗？
李云岫和芊芊给他夹什么，他就吃什么，顺便还和方少白讨论一下西域葡萄酒。
一顿午宴，宾主尽欢。
不过午宴过后，方少白就要告辞离开。
“你好歹住几天啊！”王昱拉住方少白的手留客。
“住什么呀！”方少白拉着王昱就来到了一边，低声调侃，“看你们在我面前表演二女争夫吗？”
王昱淡然道，“不要误会，不是二女争夫，她们都是我的妻子。”
方少白，“……”
“这才有点镇西王的气势！”方少白哈哈笑道，然后正色道，“令尊去世不久，你也十年未归，想必王府事务不少，我就不在这里打扰你了。”
“咱们都在西北，以后有的是时间相聚。”说到这里，方少白似乎想起了什么，“而且估计过些日子我可能还会来西北一趟。”
“对了！”方少白又说道，“如果你什么时候要对付祁山寇了，派人来太华派通知我，我带人来帮帮场子。”
“那我就不客气！”王昱说道。
“客气啥，是我得谢谢你。”方少白也不隐瞒，“祁山寇中多有各派不肖弟子，其中就有我的一个师叔。”
王昱了然，心说怪不得有这么多高手落草为寇，原来是报团取暖，祁山寇就是个类似于恶人谷的组织。
……

从王府牵了一匹好马，方少白打马而去。
接下来，赵嵘安排赵英杰带着李云岫主仆去参观镇西王府，然后便独自带着王昱来到了王府后面的主院落。
“你爹不是病死的！”赵嵘背对着王昱，第一句话便石破天惊，“他是被人害死的！”
王昱眼神一跳，立刻问道，“是谁？”
“是先帝。”赵嵘也没有卖关子，回头看向王昱，“你应该还记得十年前的事情吧？”
王昱面颊一抽，“十年前，我爹把我送去京城为质，但具体原因，我爹没说。”
赵嵘叹了口气，“因为当年你还太小，跟你说了也没用，而且说不定还会引起他人觊觎。”
“三十多年前，义父他老人家带兵纵横西北，割据一方，朝廷虽然定鼎天下，但也不敢说可以轻松覆灭咱们。”
赵嵘抬头看向天边的云彩，眼中露出追忆之色，“于是朝廷封义父为镇西王，世袭罔替，并且交割陇山、庆安、凤鸣三府，官员由咱们指定，赋税由王府支配。
王府名义上归顺朝廷，替朝廷镇守西北，抵御漠北羌人，但权、钱、军自理，听调不听宣，也算国中之国。”
王昱点点头，赵嵘说的都是陈年旧事，他当然早已知道。
“十五年前，随着义父归天，很多人以为王府即将衰落，不过义兄横空出世，一柄火云刀纵横大漠，横行西北，带兵出关大胜羌族，成为天下最年轻的先天宗师之一，声望一时无两，便是朝廷也多有忌惮。”
提到赵峥，赵嵘的声音带着崇拜，眼神也放出光芒。
不过他的眼神很快暗淡，“但十年前，他南下星宿海，一切都变了。”
王昱接话道，“和星宿老人徒弟的那一战？”
“不错。”赵嵘点点头，“世人都知道义兄以一敌二，大胜宿海双星，砍断了摘星子的胳膊和追星子的腿，但却不知道他自己也受了极严重的内伤。”
赵嵘叹息道，“可惜咱们镇西王府还是底蕴太弱，治不了义兄的伤势，义兄不得不将少爷你送去京中为质，换取佛道二门为皇家炼制的秘药：百灵还阳丹。
义兄只有少爷你一个儿子，将你送入京中为质，其实已经是对朝廷低头，殊不知那老皇帝还不满足，竟然在百灵还阳丹中掺了一味药！
这一味药，导致义兄虽然平日里看起来外表无差，但其实丹田的伤势一直未曾痊愈，而且体内真气如火，越来越旺！”
说到这里，赵嵘眼神狰狞，“义兄若不修行，伤势就会越来越重，若是继续修行，则极易走火入魔！”

“所以我爹是走火入魔死的？”
“不错！”赵嵘眼中闪过嘲讽，“老皇帝想兵不血刃拿下咱们镇西王府，却不知道义兄比他想象中撑得还久，而他自己却征北不利，又有西南叛乱，自己先死了。
content_en:
"Husband, these lily chicken nuggets are good, you can try them."
"Brother Yu, the Yellow River carp is Master Liao's specialty. The back of the fish is the tenderest. You can eat a piece."
Wang Yu sat at the main seat, Li Yunxiu and Qianqian sat on the left and right, Fang Shaobai sat on the guest seat, Zhao Rong accompanied him at the side, and Zhao Yingjie was not qualified to sit at the table.
There are sixteen dishes on the table, eight cold, eight hot, and a maid is standing behind each person to serve them. She can pour wine and pick up the dishes at any time, so that no leftovers are left in front of the table.
But Wang Yu doesn't need it, because he is well served by Li Yunxiu and Qianqian.
He was not polite either, because the real Zhao Yu would never be polite. A princess betrothed by the emperor, a fiancée arranged by her father, shouldn't she serve the prince like herself?
He ate whatever Li Yunxiu and Qianqian gave him, and also discussed Western Region wine with Fang Shaobai.
A luncheon where the guests and hosts enjoyed themselves.
But after the luncheon, Fang Shaobai was about to say goodbye and leave.
"How many days will you stay?" Wang Yu took Fang Shaobai's hand to stay.
"Where are you staying?" Fang Shaobai pulled Wang Yu to the side and teased in a low voice, "Do you want to watch you perform two women fighting for a husband in front of me?"
Wang Yu said calmly, "Don't get me wrong, it's not that two women are fighting for a husband, they are both my wives."
Fang Shaobai, "..."
"This is a bit like the King of Zhenxi!" Fang Shaobai laughed, and then said seriously, "My father passed away not long ago, and you haven't returned for ten years. There must be a lot of business in the palace, so I won't disturb you here."
"We are all in the northwest, and we will have plenty of time to get together in the future." Speaking of this, Fang Shaobai seemed to have remembered something, "And I guess I may come to the northwest again in a few days."
"That's right!" Fang Shaobai said again, "If you are going to deal with the Qishan bandits at any time, send someone to the Taihua faction to notify me, and I will bring someone to help."
"Then I'm welcome!" Wang Yu said.
"You're welcome, I have to thank you." Fang Shaobai didn't hide it, "There are many unscrupulous disciples of various factions among the Qishan bandits, including one of my uncles."
Wang Yu understood, and thought to himself that it was no wonder that so many masters fell into bandits. It turned out that they were joining the group to keep warm. The Qishan Bandits were an organization similar to the Valley of the Wicked.
…
Fang Shaobai took a good horse from the palace and rode away.
Next, Zhao Rong arranged for Zhao Yingjie to take Li Yunxiu and his servant to visit the Zhenxi Prince's Mansion, and then took Wang Yu alone to the main courtyard behind the Prince's Mansion.
"Your father didn't die of illness!" Zhao Rong turned his back to Wang Yu, and his first sentence was shocking, "He was killed by someone!"
Wang Yu's eyes jumped and he immediately asked, "Who is it?"
"It's the late emperor." Zhao Rong didn't show off and turned to look at Wang Yu, "You should still remember what happened ten years ago, right?"
Wang Yu's cheek twitched, "Ten years ago, my father sent me to the capital as a hostage, but he didn't tell me the specific reason."
Zhao Rong sighed, "Because you were too young back then, it would be useless to tell you, and it might even arouse the covetousness of others."
"More than thirty years ago, my adoptive father led his troops across the northwest to separate one side. Although the imperial court has the power to dominate the world, it dare not say that it can easily destroy us."
Zhao Rong raised his head and looked at the clouds on the horizon, with a look of reminiscence in his eyes, "So the imperial court named my adoptive father the King of Zhenxi, hereditary, and handed over the three prefectures of Longshan, Qing'an, and Fengming. The officials were appointed by us, and the taxes were controlled by the palace.
The royal palace nominally submitted to the imperial court, guarded the northwest for the imperial court, and resisted the Mobei Qiang people. However, it took care of its own power, money, and army. It obeyed orders but not propaganda, and it was considered a country within a country. "
Wang Yu nodded. What Zhao Rong was talking about was old news. Of course he already knew it.
"Fifteen years ago, with the death of my adopted father, many people thought that the palace was about to decline. However, my adopted brother turned out to be a man with a Fire Cloud Sword that crisscrossed the desert and the northwest. He led his troops out to defeat the Qiang people and became one of the youngest Xiantian Grandmasters in the world. His reputation was unparalleled, and even the court was afraid of him."
When Zhao Zheng was mentioned, Zhao Rong's voice was filled with admiration and his eyes were shining.
But his eyes quickly dimmed, "But ten years ago, he went south to the Xingxiu Sea, and everything changed. "
Wang Yu answered, "The battle with Old Man Xingxu's apprentice? "
"good. "Zhao Rong nodded, "Everyone in the world knows that the sworn brother defeated the two stars of Suhai with one against two, and cut off the arm of the star picker and the legs of the star chaser, but they don't know that he himself also suffered extremely serious internal injuries. "
Zhao Rong sighed, "It's a pity that our Zhenxi Prince's Palace is still too weak to cure the injury of the sworn brother. The sworn brother had to send you, the young master, to the capital as a hostage in exchange for the secret medicine refined by the Buddhist and Taoist sects for the royal family: Bailing Huanyang Pill.
My sworn brother only has a son, the young master. I sent you to the capital as a hostage. In fact, I bowed my head to the court. Little did I know that the old emperor was not satisfied yet and actually mixed some medicine into the Bailing Huanyang Pill!
This medicine caused the sworn brother to appear to be fine on weekdays, but in fact, the injury in his Dantian had never healed, and the true energy in his body was like fire, getting stronger and stronger! "
Speaking of this, Zhao Rong's eyes were ferocious, "If my sworn brother does not practice, his injuries will become more and more serious. If he continues to practice, he will easily become possessed!" "
"So my father went crazy and died? "
"good! " Zhao Rong's eyes flashed with sarcasm, "The old emperor wanted to take over our Zhenxi Prince's Mansion without any bloodshed, but he didn't know that his sworn brother lasted longer than he thought, but he himself was unlucky in the expedition to the north, and there was a rebellion in the southwest, and he died first.
